title: When Personalization Misleads: Understanding and Mitigating Hallucinations in Personalized LLMs
authors: Zhongxiang Sun; Yi Zhan; Chenglei Shen; Weijie Yu; Xiao Zhang; Ming He; Jun Xu
method: Layer selection, trained activation probe, hard/soft/mixed factuality-preserving personalized steering.
datasets: PFQABench: personalized and factual queries; PAG/DPL/RAG/LLM-TRSR baselines
metrics_and_design: Factual and personalized QA, combined utility; component ablations.
reported_finding: Mixed steering balances the two objectives better; hard steering can reduce personalization.
limitations: Not a fixed-ledger 2B CPU reproduction; no independent reanalysis here.
PersonaSLM_overlap_and_required_test: Direct interference/fidelity overlap. Test whether supplied-ledger entity/time failures persist against steering, not merely history removal.
cost_or_adaptation: Probe fitting and activation hooks; unavailable in current pinned HTTP backend; no FPPS performance claimed.
verification_scope: Main methods 4 and experiments 5 read; appendix/code replication not completed.

title: What to Admit and How to Present: Governing Persistent Memory in LLM Agents
method: FC whole-entry and PS typed-unit admission; physical exclusion; PN/CH render identical adjudications.
models: Four development generators; DeepSeek-V4-Pro adjudication/external generation; GLM-5.2 judge
metrics_and_design: Paired tests; budget-matched random/relevance controls, correction families; judge validation only on development subset.
reported_finding: Admission reduces some harms but harms personalized use; preregistered joint improvement/preservation criterion missed.
limitations: Large-model adjudication and external judge validity limit CPU transfer.
PersonaSLM_overlap_and_required_test: Direct overlap with gating and evidence conflicts. Match retained content/budget and measure utility before originality claims.
cost_or_adaptation: Additional adjudication and generation; deterministic metadata filtering is only an adaptation.
verification_scope: Main methods 3, experiments 4-5 inspected; supplements not fully verified.

title: LongMemEval: Benchmarking Chat Assistants on Long-Term Interactive Memory
authors: Di Wu; Hongwei Wang; Wenhao Yu; Yuwei Zhang; Kai-Wei Chang; Dong Yu
method: Round decomposition, fact-expanded keys, time-aware query expansion/filtering, Chain-of-Note and JSON reading.
metrics_and_design: Retrieval recall/NDCG and downstream accuracy; budget comparisons.
reported_finding: Time-aware and expanded-key retrieval help; compressed facts alone can lose information.
limitations: Retrieval and reader effects differ; cannot transfer numerical gains to complete short ledgers.
PersonaSLM_overlap_and_required_test: Time filtering is established. Compare query-date/entity joins and retained useful memory at equal budgets.
cost_or_adaptation: Extraction/indexing models plus retrieval and reader; simple local interval filter implemented only.
verification_scope: Methods and main experiments 4-5 inspected; official ICLR proceedings status verified; full code replication absent.

title: Chain-of-Verification Reduces Hallucination in Large Language Models
authors: Shehzaad Dhuliawala; Mojtaba Komeili; Jing Xu; Roberta Raileanu; Xian Li; Asli Celikyilmaz; Jason Weston
method: Draft, plan verification questions, independently answer, revise; factored verification hides draft.
datasets: Wikidata lists; Wiki-category; closed-book MultiSpanQA; biographies
metrics_and_design: Precision/recall/F1 and FACTSCORE; joint versus factored checks.
reported_finding: Verification improves factuality; some correct content is also removed.
PersonaSLM_overlap_and_required_test: Answer verification already exists; compare component delivery and damage to correct content.
cost_or_adaptation: Several additional model calls; bounded ledger-based adaptation must be labelled adapted, with equal-compute baseline.
verification_scope: Complete main method 3 and experiment 4 inspected; appendices/code not reproduced.

title: RARR: Researching and Revising What Language Models Say, Using Language Models
authors: Luyu Gao; Zhuyun Dai; Panupong Pasupat; Anthony Chen; Arun Tejasvi Chaganty; Yicheng Fan; Vincent Zhao; Ni Lao; Hongrae Lee; Da-Cheng Juan; Kelvin Guu
method: Generate research queries, web retrieval, agreement checking, minimal edits, evidence selection.
models: PaLM540B revision; PaLM/GPT3/LaMDA source outputs; T5-large relevance
metrics_and_design: Attribution AIS and intent/edit preservation; EFEC and LaMDA research baselines.
reported_finding: Improves attribution while preserving more source intent than aggressive alternatives.
limitations: Large verifier/search cost; attribution is not complete requested-task success.
PersonaSLM_overlap_and_required_test: Evidence verification is prior art. Closed-ledger revision needs no-search and equal-call baselines.
cost_or_adaptation: Multiple calls and search; no paid API or web-data ingestion implemented.
verification_scope: Main methods 3 and experiments 5 inspected; full appendix/implementation replication absent.

title: Persistent Personas? Role-Playing, Instruction Following, and Safety in Extended Interactions
authors: Pedro Henrique Luz de Araujo; Michael A. Hedderich; Ali Modarressi; Hinrich Schuetze; Benjamin Roth
method: Long persona-directed/goal-oriented dialogue prefixes and shuffled queries; eight personas.
metrics_and_design: Fidelity, instruction and refusal scores; judge/human subset; bootstrap.
reported_finding: Fidelity declines with dialogue length, especially goal-oriented conversation.
limitations: Judge-based, long-context setting; short auxiliary histories are different.
PersonaSLM_overlap_and_required_test: History/fidelity trade-offs established; validate short-ledger effects independently and retain fidelity endpoint.
verification_scope: Main methods 3-4 and results 5 inspected; all appendix statistics not reproduced.

title: TwinVoice: A Multi-dimensional Benchmark Towards Digital Twins via LLM Persona Simulation
authors: Bangde Du; Minghao Guo; Songming He; Ziyi Ye; Xi Zhu; Weihang Su; Shuqi Zhu; Yujia Zhou; Yongfeng Zhang; Qingyao Ai; Yiqun Liu
method: Discriminative and generative persona evaluation; six non-orthogonal capabilities.
models: Seven models including Qwen2.5-14B, GPT5-Chat and Claude-Sonnet4
datasets: Social PChatbot; interpersonal Telegram; narrative fiction
metrics_and_design: Multiple-choice accuracy, generation ranking/scoring, capability breakdown.
reported_finding: Generation remains harder than recognition, with memory/tone weaknesses.
limitations: Judge dependence; public/private-source governance differs from synthetic research.
PersonaSLM_overlap_and_required_test: Multidimensional fidelity is established; independent ledger reliability and boundary validity remain separate questions.
cost_or_adaptation: Generation plus judge; no original personal conversations imported.
verification_scope: Main methods 3 and experiments 4 read; appendices NOT FULLY VERIFIED.

title: Wiki-Talkie: Multilingual Benchmarking of Persona-Based Agents on Real-World Discussions
authors: Dennis Fucci; Andrea Bacciu; Dong Liu; Weronika Lajewska; Saab Mansour
method: Ground-truth preceding context with five conditioning schemes across five languages.
metrics_and_design: ROUGE/BERTScore, dialogue-act JSD, sentiment Wasserstein distances.
reported_finding: History supports closer population behavior than abstract persona profiles.
limitations: Model identities anonymized; population fidelity differs from individual factual correctness.
PersonaSLM_overlap_and_required_test: History conditioning already studied; new contribution requires fixed-evidence reliability and governed external validation.
cost_or_adaptation: Next-turn generation and behavioral annotation; no data collected here.
verification_scope: Main methods 4 and results 5 inspected; appendices not fully verified.

title: Decoupling Logic from Persona: Structural Immunity of Edge LLM Agents to Context Pollution
method: AO-DA separates logic/persona paths using structured state and adapter switching.
models: Llama3.1-8B; Gemma3-4B; INT4 on Apple M2/MLX
datasets: Two primary tasks, two personas, five seeds; low/high pollution
metrics_and_design: Paired tests, corrected comparison families, schema/raw/spoken scores.
reported_finding: Low-pollution logic result is null; clean logic path invariance is by construction.
limitations: Two tasks, adapter/runtime differences and extra decode; raw versus schema results differ.
PersonaSLM_overlap_and_required_test: Separation and measurement discrepancies overlap directly. Test user-facing benefit under matched compute and independent boundaries.
cost_or_adaptation: Two paths and adapters; no training or replication attempted.
verification_scope: Main methods 3-4 and results 5 inspected; appendix/code replication absent.

title: LongMemEval-V2: Evaluating Long-Term Agent Memory Toward Experienced Colleagues
authors: Di Wu; Zixiang Ji; Asmi Kawatkar; Bryan Kwan; Jia-Chen Gu; Nanyun Peng; Kai-Wei Chang
method: AgentRunbook-R multi-pool retrieval; AgentRunbook-C files, workflow and manifest-guided context gathering.
models: Qwen3.5-9B reader/controller; Qwen3-Embedding-8B; hosted agent alternative
metrics_and_design: Fixed-reader accuracy and query latency; paired bootstrap, ablations.
reported_finding: Structured memory improves accuracy/latency trade-offs; oracle trajectories still require competent reading.
limitations: Very long multimodal contexts; selected questions and hosted models differ from CPU short ledgers.
PersonaSLM_overlap_and_required_test: Evidence presence versus use is already studied; fixed short evidence is a controlled complement, not new retrieval invention.
cost_or_adaptation: Large indexing/reader context; no CPU implementation claim.
verification_scope: Newly discovered; main design 3, algorithm 4 and experiments 5 inspected; appendices NOT FULLY VERIFIED.
